selector.rationale: High titers of ANA, anti–double-stranded DNA, and anti–Smith antibodies, along with low complement C3 levels and evidence of renal involvement, strongly support Systemic Lupus Erythematosus as the most comprehensive diagnosis.

rejected.label: Hyporeninemic Hypoaldosteronism
rejected.why: While the patient has hyperkalemia and low aldosterone levels, these findings are also consistent with renal involvement in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus.

rejected.label: Serositis
rejected.why: Although the patient has pleural and pericardial effusions, these are better explained by the systemic nature of Systemic Lupus Erythematosus rather than as a standalone diagnosis of Serositis.
